note: Rewritten from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source describes soldiers and workers and records alates as unknown. In the source the total body length of the soldier is given once as 4.5–15.9 mm, an inconsistent pair of figures, probably OCR damage, and is therefore omitted. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been deleted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to dark brown; antennae yellowish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; body straw yellow. Head sparsely pilose, body moderately pilose. Head capsule long, rectangular, sides nearly parallel; length to mandibular base 1.6–1.9 mm, maximum width 1.0–1.13 mm, width/length ratio 0.58–0.60. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest, segment 4 longer than segment 5. Labrum pentagonal; anterolateral angles distinctly angulate, anterior margin slightly pointed medially; wider than long (length 0.15–0.25 mm, width 0.30–0.40 mm). Mandibles strongly curved, falcate, apex acute and incurved (length 0.95–1.15 mm); slightly longer than half the head (left mandible length/head length ratio 0.55–0.63), basal half of inner margin coarsely serrate. Postmentum rod-shaped, slightly constricted behind the middle at the waist (length 1.0–1.15 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm, waist width 0.18–0.20 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.33–0.43 mm, width 0.65–0.73 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and antennae pale yellow; body paler than the head. Head moderately pilose, body densely pilose. Total body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, length to mandibular base 0.75–1.08 mm, maximum width 0.85–1.10 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest, segment 4 longer than segment 5. Postclypeus convex, pilose; length slightly more than half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin shallowly concave (length 0.28–0.33 mm, width 0.50–0.60 mm).
